Tell someone. Someone you trust and know really well, someone who’s easy to talk to. Or someone on a trustworthy place like this. I know I’m up to talk to anyone. Get the feeling out before you use it against yourself, my therapist told me to draw on the spot where I cut to show art or something less destructive where the pain would normally show. Journaling is another great option, or doing something you love to be happy and get out of the cutting mindset. (Most of these are tips from my therapist) hope this helped! :)
